project.name: MatrimonyApp
project.description: A trust-focused matrimonial application with a React frontend and microservices backend.

initiatives.title: Build Matrimony Platform
initiatives.description: Develop a complete, trust-focused matchmaking ecosystem with a React frontend and microservices backend.

epics.title: Level 1 — Foundation MVP
epics.description: Establish the minimum functional experience: authentication, basic onboarding, partner preferences, photo manager, search discovery, and interest exchange.

epics.title: Level 2 — Trust & Engagement
epics.description: Implement credentials verification badges, saved searches, in-app messaging, visitor tracking, and block/report moderation tools.

epics.title: Level 3 — Premium Matchmaking
epics.description: Introduce monetization mechanics via subscriptions, smart recommendations, profile boosts, and compatibility scores.

epics.title: Level 4 — Intelligence & Rich Interactions
epics.description: Incorporate automated Selfie & Govt ID verification, video profiles, secure voice/video calling, and AI conversation suggestions.

epics.title: Level 5 — Ecosystem & Expansion
epics.description: Add an AI Matchmaking Assistant, wedding services marketplace, relationship counseling resources, and regional community portals.

epics.title: Feature: User Authentication (Multiple Methods)
epics.description: Allows users to securely register and access the platform via Mobile OTP and Email Magic Links.

epics.title: Feature: User Profile Management & Editing
epics.description: Multi-step wizard to create and edit matrimonial profiles capturing personal, family, academic, and lifestyle traits.

epics.title: Feature: Partner Preferences
epics.description: Configure preferences for age, height, community, languages, and location.

epics.title: Feature: Profile Photos Manager
epics.description: Manage profile images, primary avatar, and photo visibility controls.

epics.title: Feature: Match Discovery (Search & Filtering)
epics.description: Profile search, active filters, geo-location queries, and daily match scoring alerts.

epics.title: Feature: Interest Management (Send / Accept / Reject)
epics.description: Express interest, dashboard to manage received/sent states, and double-opt-in logic.

epics.title: Feature: System & Activity Notifications
epics.description: Push, email, and in-app updates regarding interest updates and daily recommendations.

epics.title: Feature: Basic Privacy Controls
epics.description: Profile visibility settings, blur controls for non-matched profiles, and API gateway contact details masking.

stories.title: Mobile OTP Request UI & API Flow
stories.description: Implement the mobile phone number input form in the login screen, with an API endpoint that generates a 6-digit OTP, stores it in Redis with a 5-minute TTL, and triggers the SMS gateway delivery.
stories.businessValue: Critical - Initial point of entry and security boundary for serious seekers.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen renders a clean mobile number input conforming to standard E.164 formats.
Submit button sends a POST request to '/api/v1/auth/otp/send' with phone number payload.
Endpoint generates a random 6-digit OTP, saves phone number as key in Redis with 300 seconds TTL.
SMS dispatch completes successfully or invokes a mock carrier callback for logging.

stories.title: OTP Verification & Token Emission
stories.description: Implement code verification form and backend validation logic which confirms the Redis OTP key, issues short-lived Access Token (JWT) and sets standard session cookies.
stories.businessValue: Critical - Authenticates identity and unlocks the onboarding wizard.
acceptanceCriteria: OTP verification overlay renders 6 numeric character inputs.
POST request sent to '/api/v1/auth/otp/verify' containing phone number and OTP code.
Server validates input matching active Redis record, signs HS256 Access Token, and registers active UserAccount in PostgreSQL.
Success response returns HTTP-Only session tokens, redirecting user to Onboarding wizard.

stories.title: Email Magic Link Login
stories.description: Develop email sign-in route enabling users to submit their email and verify credentials by clicking a temporary passwordless login token sent via email.
stories.businessValue: High - Offers backup passwordless login method for professionals on desktops.
acceptanceCriteria: Option to switch to Email Login visible on login dialog.
POST request to '/api/v1/auth/magic-link/send' initiates temporary login ticket (15-min expiry).
Dispatches SendGrid / SES transactional template containing unique authorization link.
Clicking link validates signature at '/api/v1/auth/magic-link/verify' and authenticates session.

stories.title: Session Management & Silent Refresh Tokens
stories.description: Configure token rotation policies including 15-minute Access Token lifespan, automated HTTP-Only cookie silent refresh, and logout blacklist hooks.
stories.businessValue: High - Secures platform sessions from active interception and token abuse.
acceptanceCriteria: Gateway verifies JWT validity checking signature, expiration, and verified claims.
React app triggers Axios interceptor to execute '/api/v1/auth/refresh' silently before 15-minute token expiry.
Logout endpoint blacklists access tokens inside Redis for remainder of payload lifetime.

stories.title: OTP Lockout Brute Force Prevention
stories.description: Implement rate limiting and security lockout policies that block OTP checks for an hour upon consecutive failures.
stories.businessValue: High - Mitigates automated dictionary and OTP brute force attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Store login failure count in Redis tied to target phone key.
Upon 3 consecutive incorrect OTP entries, raise 'OTP_VERIFICATION_LOCKED' error response.
Reject all subsequent attempts for 1 hour, returning code 429.

stories.title: Personal Details Onboarding Form
stories.description: Design step 1 of the onboarding wizard capturing basic identity and attributes using React and Neumorphic design assets.
stories.businessValue: High - Captures basic user characteristics necessary for matching engine ingestion.
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard collects Name, Gender, DOB (verifies age is >= 18 years), Height in cm, and Mother Tongue.
Inputs utilize Neumorphic inset deep shadow wells with active accent highlighting.
Enforces inline validation for missing inputs prior to enabling 'Next' button.

stories.title: Family Background Information Step
stories.description: Design step 2 of the onboarding wizard mapping parent and family traits tailored for parent segments.
stories.businessValue: High - Satisfies critical job of Family-Assisted seekers needing background details.
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard collects Family Type (Nuclear/Joint), Parents' Occupations, Family Status, and Family Values.
Utilizes standard dropdown boxes restricted strictly to system-configured database values.
Integrates wizard navigation permitting backward step retrieval without data loss.

stories.title: Career, Education & Lifestyle Form Onboarding
stories.description: Design step 3 of onboarding wizard mapping highest educational degree, university details, current occupation, industry, income range, and lifestyle details.
stories.businessValue: High - Collects career parameters crucial for matchmaking compatibility sorting.
acceptanceCriteria: Wizard fields map Highest Degree, University, Current Occupation, Industry, Annual Income Range.
Captures lifestyle factors: Diet (Veg/Non-Veg/Eggitarian) and habits (smoking/drinking).
Form submission triggers profile initialization POST payload to '/api/v1/profiles/onboard'.

stories.title: Profile Completion Checklist UI
stories.description: Implement profile completion progress indicator in React, showing progress steps and prompting users on missing attributes.
stories.businessValue: Medium - Incentivizes users to complete all wizard steps for better visibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Progress indicator displays percentage status calculated dynamically based on filled database properties.
Cheklist prompts user to complete missing blocks (e.g. upload photo, input preferences).
Enforces constraints: Profile cannot reach 100% completion unless at least one valid avatar photo is uploaded.

stories.title: Profile Editor Dashboard Settings
stories.description: Implement a dashboard component allowing users to view, manage, and update their profile variables post-onboarding.
stories.businessValue: High - Enables users to correct details and change attributes over time.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard fetches current user metadata and presents it in read-only Neumorphic clay containers.
Clicking field toggles edit inputs, validated against server rules upon saving.
PUT requests update 'user_profiles' table and trigger RabbitMQ 'user.profile.updated' sync event.

stories.title: Partner Preference Slider & Multi-Select UI Settings
stories.description: Build user preferences panel allowing seekers to establish desired match bounds for potential profiles.
stories.businessValue: High - Essential component for tailoring user recommendations and discovery scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders dual-thumb Neumorphic range sliders for age (min 18, max 70) and height boundaries.
Supports multi-select tag inputs for Religions, Languages, and Locations.
Settings page provides a 'Save Preferences' button sending config to Profile Service backend.

stories.title: Partner Preference Server Validation & Defaults
stories.description: Develop backend validation logic for preferences table, enforcing input bounds and writing default values for incomplete preference profiles.
stories.businessValue: Medium - Keeps search parameters within valid ranges and prevents indexing faults.
acceptanceCriteria: API service rejects ranges failing core boundaries (e.g. min age < 18, min height <= 0).
If profile is loaded with empty parameters, defaults preference fields based on user's own regional location.

stories.title: Preferences-Search Index Integration
stories.description: Establish profile database triggers and jobs syncing modified preferences directly to the user metadata cache to update recommendations.
stories.businessValue: High - Ensures matches updates respond instantly to changes in preferences.
acceptanceCriteria: Saves target filters to 'partner_preferences' table.
Emits update event on message queue triggering Search service recommendations cache reload.

stories.title: Multi-Photo File Drag & Drop Component
stories.description: Build media upload container in React allowing users to drag and drop up to 5 profile images, with size checks and type filtering.
stories.businessValue: High - Enables users to personalize profiles with images securely.
acceptanceCriteria: Uploader supports drag-and-drop or select file triggers for up to 5 items.
Validates size (max 5MB per file) and MIME type (.jpg, .jpeg, .png only) client-side.
Displays loader and preview states on cards using Neumorphic inset wells.

stories.title: Secure S3 Upload & Signed URL Logic
stories.description: Implement Media Service API endpoint that issues temporary presigned S3 URLs for client direct uploads and generates 15-minute TTL URLs for image retrieval.
stories.businessValue: Critical - Protects raw media storage bucket and restricts public media access.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct requests for raw bucket files blocked; files must be requested through secure temporary signed links.
API endpoint returns JSON mapping S3 upload destination and unique keys.
Client signs uploads directly to target S3 storage bucket; server indexes path in 'profile_photos' table.

stories.title: Avatar Setting & Photo Visibility Controls
stories.description: Build settings UI for managing uploaded pictures, setting primary display avatar, and applying privacy options.
stories.businessValue: High - Supports privacy controls requested by Independent Professionals.
acceptanceCriteria: Photo cards render actions to 'Set as Profile Picture' and toggle visibility (Public, Accepted Only, Hidden).
Changing photo visibility flags instantly updates profile database record.
Toggling visibility to 'Hidden' emits a search sync event removing that photo from elastic index.

stories.title: Match Discovery Sidebar & Card Grid UI
stories.description: Construct match browse screen rendering profile listings as Neumorphic cards, with side panels for basic filters.
stories.businessValue: High - Main dashboard view for search and user matchmaking interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Matches display as heavy rounded (32px) cards using Extruded Resting layout.
Hovering over profile card triggers smooth translateY movement and shadow transition.
Browse page Sidebar provides filters for Location, Religion, Language, and Age bounds.

stories.title: Elasticsearch Geo-Location & Filter Sync
stories.description: Implement Elasticsearch query handler inside Search Service parsing geodistance search variables and attribute keywords.
stories.businessValue: High - Delivers sub-150ms geo-proximity search results.
acceptanceCriteria: Search service maps incoming HTTP GET params to Elasticsearch JSON query clauses.
Validates location coordinates utilizing geodistance boundary filters.
Results returned include only matched criteria, calculating accuracy compatibility scores.

stories.title: Daily Recommended Matches Engine
stories.description: Build batch recommendations scheduler compiling 10 high-quality matching profiles for users daily.
stories.businessValue: High - Retains users by delivering fresh daily compatibility lists.
acceptanceCriteria: Matchmaker worker runs cron task evaluating preferences compatibility score (> 80%).
Serves exactly 10 curated profile objects to the user match cache.
Publishes 'match.recommendations.served' notification payload on successful compile.

stories.title: Inactive Profile Search Exclusions
stories.description: Incorporate automated cleanups filtering out profiles inactive for 90 days from the search index.
stories.businessValue: Medium - Keeps matchmaking index populated only with active, serious seekers.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile database records capture user's last login date.
Sync script updates Elasticsearch index, setting query filter 'is_active: false' for records without recent logins.
Excluded profiles do not appear in recommendations or user filters.

stories.title: Send Connection Interest Button
stories.description: Build 'Send Interest' interaction hook on profile cards triggering connection request to target profile.
stories.businessValue: High - Enables initial contact interaction between serious seekers.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile cards render clear 'Send Interest' call-to-action button.
Clicking posts data to '/api/v1/interests' modifying request status in Profile Database.
Button instantly shifts to disabled 'Interest Sent' state on success.

stories.title: Accept & Decline Connection Action Flows
stories.description: Implement Accept and Decline action hooks on incoming interest records, unlocking connection states.
stories.businessValue: High - Establishes double opt-in protocol ensuring safe communication paths inside platform.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard displays actions to Approve or Decline received interests.
Approving request changes status to MATCHED and sends RabbitMQ 'match.interest.accepted' event.
Declining interest removes it from view, setting state to ARCHIVED without notifying sender.

stories.title: Connection Inbox Dashboard View
stories.description: Construct inbox view filtering connection requests into categorized tabs: Sent, Received, and Matches.
stories.businessValue: High - Organizes interest status tracking and active chats.
acceptanceCriteria: Inbox panel splits requests into 'Received Interests', 'Sent Interests', and 'Accepted Matches'.
Lists display sender avatars, matched tags, and creation dates.
Accepted matches include badge shortcuts linking directly to Chat window.

stories.title: Duplicate Interest Prevention Engine
stories.description: Implement checks verifying that only single connection requests can exist between two profiles.
stories.businessValue: Medium - Prevents spamming and double entries in database logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Database constraints prevent duplicate records for same sender-receiver pairs.
If sender issues a second interest while status is PENDING, service blocks query and logs request.

stories.title: In-App Notification Center UI
stories.description: Build notification tray in main header layout displaying real-time updates and unread counts.
stories.businessValue: High - Updates users instantly on matching activities while inside application.
acceptanceCriteria: Header bell icon shows red numeric badge representing unread notifications count.
Clicking icon displays Neumorphic overlay listing recent match actions.
Clicking individual notification updates record state to read and routes user to action source.

stories.title: Push Notification Dispatcher integration
stories.description: Establish Notification Service worker listening to RabbitMQ events and triggering real-time alerts.
stories.businessValue: Medium - Engages users with out-of-app updates when connections occur.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification service consumes 'user.auth.created' and 'match.interest.accepted' event streams.
Triggers push notifications callback via external provider client integrations.

stories.title: Daily Email Digest Scheduler
stories.description: Build email digest worker aggregating profile recommendations and dispatching summary sheets.
stories.businessValue: Low - Re-engages passive seekers using standard email digests.
acceptanceCriteria: Cron scheduler executes daily compiled user digests from Redis recommendation lists.
Dispatches personalized SendGrid templates listing match counts and verification status.
Emails contain direct links back to matched profiles.

stories.title: Active Chat Notification Suppression
stories.description: Implement checks suppressing in-app notifications if user is already viewing the target communication thread.
stories.businessValue: Medium - Improves UX by preventing redundant notifications during active messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: Client maps currently focused conversation IDs in state manager.
If a notification is received for an active conversation, suppress the alert sound and bubble UI.

stories.title: Profile Visibility Search Settings
stories.description: Build settings toggles permitting users to set profiles to fully private, removing records from active search databases.
stories.businessValue: High - Delivers primary privacy control requested by serious seekers.
acceptanceCriteria: Privacy settings render visibility toggle switch (Public vs Hidden).
Changing toggle sends PUT payload updating PostgreSQL state.
Hidden profiles are immediately removed from Elasticsearch results.

stories.title: Photo Blurring Visbility Middleware
stories.description: Build API middleware delivering blurred photo versions to unverified or unmatched search requests.
stories.businessValue: Critical - Prevents image scraping and unauthorized user indexing.
acceptanceCriteria: Profiles endpoint checks request status between source and target IDs.
If status is not MATCHED, rewrite CDN photo URLs to point to pre-blurred placeholder assets.
High-definition image URLs are only returned upon double opt-in verification.

stories.title: Server-Side API Contact Details Masking
stories.description: Implement hard masking filter at the API Gateway level to block email and phone parameters unless connection status is MATCHED.
stories.businessValue: Critical - Secures sensitive personal credentials from public access.
acceptanceCriteria: API Gateway scans search and profile responses.
Unless relationship type is MATCHED, mask phone numbers (e.g. +91******340) and emails (e.g. ar***@domain.com) server-side.
Enforces phone number masking prior to payload delivery to React frontend client.

stories.title: Risk Mitigation: High Onboarding Drop-Off Rate
stories.description: Design user analytics monitoring for multi-step onboarding wizard to identify and optimize fields causing user sign-off friction.
stories.businessValue: Risk Mitigation - Decreases user drop-off during mandatory verification and onboarding stages.
acceptanceCriteria: React wizard triggers 'onboarding_wizard_step' telemetry event on step transition.
Telemetry reports containing step number and elapsed time are pushed to analytics service database.
Enables identification of onboarding bottlenecks.

stories.title: Risk Mitigation: Chat Platform Bypass Checks
stories.description: Develop client regex filter blocking phone number sharing inside chat conversations during initial connection stages.
stories.businessValue: Risk Mitigation - Encourages serious seekers to use safe communication paths inside platform.
acceptanceCriteria: Chat routing service evaluates outgoing text payloads.
Uses regular expressions checking for common phone number patterns.
Replaces detected digits with masking placeholder characters and displays warning notice to user.

stories.title: Spike: SMS OTP Gateway Verification Integration Path
stories.description: Research API integration paths, delivery speed, and cost matrices for Twilio vs AWS SNS providers.
stories.businessValue: Technical spike to investigate OTP dispatch latency targets (< 2 seconds).
acceptanceCriteria: Produce architectural spike summary detailing pricing models and sandbox setup constraints.
Validate p95 gateway response latency is within standard limits (< 2 seconds).
Select primary and fallback SMS gateway provider endpoints.

stories.title: Spike: Elasticsearch Geofenced Matches Indexing
stories.description: Benchmark geo-point query performance and distance sorting latency inside Elasticsearch indexing engine.
stories.businessValue: Technical spike verifying Elasticsearch search latency limits (< 150ms) for radius filters.
acceptanceCriteria: Establish local Docker index instance with dummy profile locations.
Verify query latency performance under concurrent reads.
Document geo-point mapping options and index schema configurations.

comments.message: Release mapping context: All Level 1 MVP user stories (STORY-001 through STORY-031), along with active risks (RISK-001/002) and spikes (SPIKE-001/002) are targeted for Version 1.0.0 (REL-001) scheduled for delivery in 8 weeks.
